user.title: Cloudless RMV – access key
user.description: Enter your own RMV Open Data key. Request one for free at {open_data_url}. The key stays private and is only stored in your Home Assistant instance.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew key
reauth_confirm.description: The key was rejected. Enter a new key from {open_data_url}.

stop.title: Find stop
stop.description: Name of the stop where you board.

direction.title: Direction (optional)
direction.description: Only show trips towards this stop (e.g. Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof). Leave empty for all directions.

watch.title: Stops to check
watch.description: Stops where you want to know whether the train calls there. So far: {added}. Leave empty and submit to continue.

connection.title: Onward connection (optional)
connection.description: Checks whether services run from one of your transfer stops to a destination (e.g. tram to Friedensbrücke). So far: {added}. Leave empty to finish.

error.quota: RMV request limit reached – try again later.

init.title: Settings
init.description: To change stops, delete the entry and add it again.
